
# Attempt 3, partial dependence plots for categorical predictors
## Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpattern)
library(patchwork)
library(pdp)
library(ranger)
library(ggsci)
```

## Global plotting settings
```{r}
source("./_config.r")
DIR_PLOTS <- "08_plotting/plots"

# Report column width in inches (147 mm)
REPORT_WIDTH_IN <- 147 / 25.4
PANEL_SIZE_IN   <- REPORT_WIDTH_IN / 2   # panel width = half page width
PANEL_HEIGHT_IN <- REPORT_WIDTH_IN / 4   # panel height = quarter page width

# Load color PALette
PAL <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)

# Set global theme for ggplot2
theme_set(
    theme_classic() + # Start with a base theme
    theme(
    # 1. Globaly set font family and size for all text elements
    text = element_text(
        family = "Sans", # Global font family
        size = 20          # Global base font size
    ),

    # 2. Fine-tuning for specific elements (overrides the global setting)
    # Axis titles
    axis.title = element_text(
        size = 8, 
        color = "black"
    ),

    # Axis text (text on the axes)
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),

    # Legend titles
    legend.title = element_text(
        size = 8, 
        face = "bold"
    ),
    # Legend text (text next to the symbols in the legend)
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
)
```

## Global constants for plotting
```{r}
# Categorical variables — rendered as bar charts instead of line PDPs
CATEGORICAL_VARS <- c("aspect_factor", "mowing_intensity_factor", "mow_int_cat",
                      "TypoCH_1st_code", "LU_4")

# Human-readable labels for every potential predictor (used in PDP and importance plots)
VAR_LABELS <- c(
  # Climate — cross-sectional
  bio3                = "Isothermality (BIO3)",
  bio4                = "Temp. Seasonality (BIO4)",
  bio10               = "Temp. Warmest Quarter (BIO10)",
  bio11               = "Temp. Coldest Quarter (BIO11)",
  bio18               = "Precip. Warmest Quarter (BIO18)",
  bio19               = "Precip. Coldest Quarter (BIO19)",
  radiation_y_15yr    = "Solar Radiation (15-yr avg)",
  # Climate — change baselines
  bio3_baseline       = "Isothermality baseline (BIO3)",
  bio4_baseline       = "Temp. Seasonality baseline (BIO4)",
  bio10_baseline      = "Temp. Warmest Qtr. baseline (BIO10)",
  bio11_baseline      = "Temp. Coldest Qtr. baseline (BIO11)",
  bio18_baseline      = "Precip. Warmest Qtr. baseline (BIO18)",
  bio19_baseline      = "Precip. Coldest Qtr. baseline (BIO19)",
  # Climate — change trends
  bio3_slope          = "Isothermality trend (BIO3)",
  bio4_slope          = "Temp. Seasonality trend (BIO4)",
  bio10_slope         = "Temp. Warmest Qtr. trend (BIO10)",
  bio11_slope         = "Temp. Coldest Qtr. trend (BIO11)",
  bio18_slope         = "Precip. Warmest Qtr. trend (BIO18)",
  bio19_slope         = "Precip. Coldest Qtr. trend (BIO19)",
  # Vegetation/Habitat
  veg_height          = "Vegetation Height (m)",
  TypoCH_1st_code     = "Habitat Type (TypoCH)",
  # Topography/Soil
  aspect_factor       = "Aspect",
  slope               = "Slope (\u00b0)",
  tpi                 = "Topographic Position Index (TPI)",
  twi                 = "Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)",
  soc_stock_0_120     = "Soil Organic Carbon (t/ha)",
  humus_0_30          = "Humus Content",
  kak_0_30            = "Cation Exchange Capacity (KAK)",
  ph_0_30             = "Soil pH",
  sand_0_30           = "Sand Content (%)",
  # Land Use
  LU_4                = "Land Use (4 classes)",
  mow_int_cat         = "Mowing Intensity"
)

# Return a pretty label for a variable name, falling back to cleaned snake_case
var_label <- function(v) {
  if (v %in% names(VAR_LABELS)) VAR_LABELS[[v]] else gsub("_", " ", v)
}
```

## Helper
```{r helper}
# Significant categorical variables from one importance data frame
select_sig_cat_vars <- function(imp_df) {
  imp_df |>
    dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05, variable %in% CATEGORICAL_VARS) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(importance)) |>
    dplyr::pull(variable)
}

# Build one bar-chart panel for a single categorical predictor.
# yhat is mean-centred so bars show deviation from the group average,
# making the response pattern of each category comparable across taxon groups.
make_one_factor_panel <- function(var, models, datasets, sig_per_model,
                                  taxon_labels, colors) {
  pd_list <- lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
    if (!var %in% colnames(datasets[[nm]])) return(NULL)
    pd        <- pdp::partial(models[[nm]], pred.var = var, train = datasets[[nm]])
    pd$yhat   <- pd$yhat - mean(pd$yhat)
    pd$taxon  <- taxon_labels[[nm]]
    pd$is_sig <- var %in% sig_per_model[[nm]]
    pd
  })
  pd_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(pd_list)
  y_min  <- min(pd_all$yhat) * 0.97

  ggplot(pd_all, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = yhat, fill = taxon)) +
    ggpattern::geom_col_pattern(
      aes(pattern = is_sig),
      position        = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width           = 0.7,
      pattern_angle   = 45,
      pattern_density = 0.01,
      pattern_spacing = 0.04,
      pattern_colour  = "white",
      pattern_fill    = "white"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL,
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pattern = "none"))) +
    scale_pattern_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "none", `FALSE` = "stripe"), guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, NA)) +
    labs(x = var_label(var), y = "") +   # y label set once on first panel below
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# Collect all significant categorical predictors, build one panel each, then stack.
# The shared y-axis label is placed only on the first (top) panel.
make_factor_pdp_stack <- function(models, datasets, imp_dfs, taxon_labels, colors) {
  sig_per_model <- lapply(imp_dfs, select_sig_cat_vars)
  all_vars      <- unique(unlist(sig_per_model))

  if (length(all_vars) == 0L) {
    message("No significant categorical variables found.")
    return(list(plot = patchwork::plot_spacer(), n_vars = 0L))
  }

  plots <- lapply(all_vars, make_one_factor_panel,
                  models        = models,
                  datasets      = datasets,
                  sig_per_model = sig_per_model,
                  taxon_labels  = taxon_labels,
                  colors        = colors)

  plots[[1]]  <- plots[[1]] + labs(y = "Partial dependence (centered)")

  list(
    plot   = patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1) +
               patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect_y") &
               theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
                     legend.box.margin = margin(t = -3, unit = "mm")) &
               labs(y = "Partial dependence (centered)"),
    n_vars = length(plots)
  )
}
```

## Species richness, factor PDPs
```{r factor-pdp-richness}
TAXON_COLORS_RICHNESS <- c("Bryophyte Richness" = PAL[9], "Plant Richness" = PAL[10])

out_richness <- make_factor_pdp_stack(
  models       = list(moss = rf_moss_richness,  plant = rf_plant_richness),
  datasets     = list(moss = moss_richness_data, plant = plant_richness_data),
  imp_dfs      = list(moss = imp_moss_richness,  plant = imp_plant_richness),
  taxon_labels = list(moss = "Bryophyte Richness", plant = "Plant Richness"),
  colors       = TAXON_COLORS_RICHNESS
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "combined_richness_factor_pdp.png"),
  plot     = out_richness$plot,
  width    = PANEL_SIZE_IN,
  height   = PANEL_HEIGHT_IN * out_richness$n_vars,
  dpi      = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

## Richness change, factor PDPs
```{r factor-pdp-change}
TAXON_COLORS_CHANGE <- c("Bryophyte Change" = PAL[9], "Plant Change" = PAL[10])

out_change <- make_factor_pdp_stack(
  models       = list(moss = rf_moss_change,  plant = rf_plant_change),
  datasets     = list(moss = moss_change_data, plant = plant_change_data),
  imp_dfs      = list(moss = imp_moss_change,  plant = imp_plant_change),
  taxon_labels = list(moss = "Bryophyte Change", plant = "Plant Change"),
  colors       = TAXON_COLORS_CHANGE
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "combined_change_factor_pdp.png"),
  plot     = out_change$plot,
  width    = PANEL_SIZE_IN,
  height   = PANEL_HEIGHT_IN * out_change$n_vars,
  dpi      = 300, bg = "white"
)
```
